hooks.text: 炼金超级士兵亲自作战并同步布置塔防
hooks.excerpt: Castle of Alchemists is an action-RPG and tower defence hybrid where you take on the role of Bellator, an alchemically enhanced super soldier and fight against relentless hordes of enemies from other worlds.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 随机词条武器制作叠加突变技能树成长
hooks.excerpt: Craft an arsenal of weapons and items with randomised properties. Mutate and hone your skills through detailed skill trees.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 金属导电、燃油点火与酸液电解形成连锁陷阱
hooks.excerpt: Utilise synergies to quickly dispatch enemies: put metal traps struck by electric, set ablaze oils, or electrify acid puddles to spread explosive poisonous gases.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
